Under PP-2023 s4.1, effective 1 October 2023 and superseding PP-2019 in full, all despatches are ex-works, so freight, transit insurance and unloading on a Rs 3,00,000 (Rs 3 lakh) order shipped in February 2024 are 100% to the buyer's account irrespective of order value. PP-2019 s4.1, which applied until 30 September 2023, made orders above Rs 2,00,000 (Rs 2 lakh) FOR destination with freight borne by DRI and orders below that freight-to-pay.

3 documents. Under VOS-7, effective 15 June 2021, step 2 has Procurement collect (1) the GST registration certificate, (2) a cancelled cheque and (3) an MSME declaration where applicable. Step 1 is the purchase requisition with vendor justification, step 3 the credit and reference check, step 4 the quality audit for direct-material vendors, step 5 vendor code creation, step 6 the trial purchase order capped at Rs 2,00,000 and step 7 the 90-day performance review; all onboarding documents are filed in The Vault within 7 days of code creation.

CFO. Under VOS-7 s3, effective 15 June 2021, a projected annual spend of Rs 14,00,000 (Rs 14 lakh) is above the Rs 10,00,000 (Rs 10 lakh) threshold, so CFO approval is required: 1 approval on the facts given. The other rows of the matrix are not triggered here - a direct-material vendor (any value) needs Plant Head + QA, that is 2 further approvals, and all other vendors need GM Procurement. Elsewhere in VOS-7 the trial purchase order at step 6 is capped at Rs 2,00,000 (Rs 2 lakh) and the performance review at step 7 falls at 90 days.

Nil (0%). Under PP-2023 s2.1, effective 1 October 2023, discounts apply on the prevailing list price per single order value: below Rs 5,00,000 (Rs 5 lakh) nil, Rs 5,00,000 to Rs 15,00,000 (Rs 5 lakh to Rs 15 lakh) 10%, above Rs 15,00,000 14%. A single order of Rs 4,20,000 (Rs 4.2 lakh) placed in March 2024 falls below the Rs 5,00,000 slab, so no discount applies, and under s2.2 slab discounts are not cumulative with scheme or campaign discounts unless expressly stated. The superseded PP-2019, which applied until 30 September 2023, gave nil below Rs 1,00,000 (Rs 1 lakh), 6% from Rs 1,00,000 to Rs 5,00,000 and 12% flat above Rs 5,00,000.
